stamp: {"keys":[{"id":"k","problem":"The current-account guide carries template sections that do not fit it (who offers it, money in and out, tax and the like), padding the page.","where":"the sections 'who', 'in and out', 'tax' of the guide","kind":"general"}],"liked":[]}

raised: Doesn't know which 'place' (study fund, investment provident fund or securities account) to use for the S&P 500; the page doesn't compare them
The second line of 'two parts of every saving' is a list of terms the reader mostly doesn't know
Retirement cards 'קרן חדשה כללית' and 'תגמולים ואישית לפיצויים' are confusing; the 'in plain language' line just repeats the title
The two self-managed cards seem to be for experts only, so they were skipped
Most cards under 'what the money is invested in' are jargon
The grey 'יומית'/'מתחדשת' buttons on the money-market card are unexplained
Can't tell MSCI World from MSCI AC World; the cards are walls of text
Unknown terms: מק"מ, אג"ח, קרן נאמנות, ברוקר, תגמולים, פיצויים, תקרה שנתית
'Exposure to the dollar or neutralized from it' isn't explained: is it good or bad?
'A fund that tracks it': who runs it and where do you buy it?
'Weighted by market value' and 'value of public holdings' aren't understood
Unclear whether the 'general track' is the default the reader is in now
Unclear which of the two kinds of study fund the reader has
The study fund's lock-in period isn't given ('a period set by law')
No fees are shown for any option
No returns or risk information (S&P 500 vs money-market fund, possible losses)
No practical tax and withdrawal comparison between investment provident fund and securities account for the S&P 500
No priority order of steps or how much money each step needs
No minimum amounts, and no word on whether small monthly deposits are possible
Would drop the 'for children' section
Would drop the Tel Aviv index cards and one of the MSCI cards
Would drop the general pension fund and the תגמולים/פיצויים cards
Would drop the T-bill (מק"מ) and government bond cards
Would drop 'what the site doesn't cover yet'

problems.why: The reader stays on the guide's overview page and never says the current-account guide has template sections like 'who', 'in and out' or 'tax' that don't fit it or pad the page.
